title: Intent shaping
summary: Take an idea from a sentence to something a team could commit to, one step at a time, against a framework that says how deep and how broad the thinking has to be.

library.summary: Take an idea from a sentence to something a team could commit to, one step at a time, against a framework that says how deep and how broad the thinking has to be.
library.prompt: Shape this into an intent using the intent-shaping skill: {{idea: your idea in a sentence or two}}

inputs.name: idea
inputs.hint: The idea: a sentence in the chat, a note, or a problem from a discovery.

when: The person has an idea, hunch or opportunity and wants to shape it or define the intent
The person asks whether an idea is ready to take to the team
not_when: Shaping a slide, a roadmap or a document's layout
A quick question about an intent already written
routing.needs: An idea in a sentence, a note, or a problem picked in discovery
routing.offer: This sounds like an idea worth shaping. Intent shaping takes it one question at a time to something the team could commit to.

start: Shape this into an intent: parents see held payments first.
Use intent shaping on the release dates idea.
offer: Parents should see held payments first. Is that a real thing?
open: What else could we do about those calls?

invariants: Never write the intent for the person
Never score an area deeper than the evidence
